description: List the brand's tracked competitors. short {id,domain,analysisState}; medium adds source,creditsCharged,lastError,addedAt,lastCrawledAt,cacheSource; full = raw. Also returns a dashboard link to the Competitors tab. Competitors added via competitor_probe_classify (direct), SEO competitors, or cluster approval are recorded with analysisState "pending" and are NOT analyzed until competitor_analyze is called (50 credits each unless the free slot is unused; subscription required after that). Rows with analysisState "pending" carry a `hint` — run competitor_analyze on them.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: competitor_list
